$doc: spec/sourcing.json - the sourcing DATA for the Microduck. Lane E (GOAL.md). One record per BOUGHT line. SOURCING.html and RFQ.html are generated from this file by tools/gen_sourcing.py; neither page is hand-maintained. Nothing here is estimated: a price is present only if it was READ on a vendor page (fetched date recorded) or read off a page a prior lane fetched and cited in docs/production/components.md. A price nobody read is null with the URL that was tried.

rules.price_basis: unit price at the vendor's own published tier. tiers[] is [order_quantity_of_the_part, unit_price]. A vendor that publishes no tier table carries tiers [[1, price]] and no_tiers=true; its @1 price is then used at every quantity as a CEILING, never as a forecast.
rules.quantity_model: For N robots the order quantity of a line is qty_per_robot x N. The unit price used is the vendor's largest tier whose quantity is <= that order quantity. If the vendor's MOQ exceeds the order quantity the MOQ tier price is used and moq_exceeds_need is set.
rules.currency: Left exactly as the vendor states it. NO FX rate was fetched, so no conversion is performed anywhere. Only USD offers enter the USD roll-up; EUR / GBP / NZD / AUD / INR lines are reported beside it, unconverted.
rules.readable_vs_unknown: The roll-up publishes TWO subtotals: the readable subtotal (lines with a read USD price) and the CANNOT DETERMINE list (lines with none). An unknown is NEVER summed as zero.
rules.verdict: PASS = two or more distributors with a price read on a page, and a unit price determinable at 1 / 100 / 1000 robots. CANNOT DETERMINE = fewer than two read prices, or none. FAIL = the line as specified cannot be bought from anyone (the part does not exist in the maker's own catalogue).

lines.mpn_status: not a bought part until a design exists
lines.rfq_spec: NOT QUOTABLE YET. 65 x 30 mm Pi-Zero-footprint HAT carrying the TLV320AIC3104 codec, a dormant BMI088 site, a Stemma J5 (JST-SH 4-pin, I2C3), the Dynamixel bus port and the battery power path. Gerbers, stackup, assembly drawing and a BOM must exist before any fab can price it. Lane D owns the design; this line exists so the sourcing roll-up records it as an UNKNOWN rather than as zero.
lines.verdict_why: There is nothing to send a fab. A quantity of boards with no Gerbers has no price, and inventing one would put a number in the roll-up that no supplier ever gave.
unknowns: Bare-board and turnkey-assembly price at 1 / 100 / 1000: CANNOT DETERMINE until lane D produces Gerbers and a placement BOM.

lines.item: imu_to_dxl v2 - custom PCB, bare board + assembly
lines.qty_basis: one board on the bus at Dynamixel Protocol-2 slave ID 200
lines.mpn_status: not a bought part until a design exists
lines.rfq_spec: NOT QUOTABLE YET. Carries the LSM6DSV16X (priced as line P2c), an unidentified MCU and an unidentified half-duplex transceiver, presenting as a Dynamixel Protocol-2 slave at ID 200. Outline unknown.
lines.verdict_why: No design, and two of its three chips are unidentified.
unknowns: Outline, MCU, transceiver, board and assembly price: all CANNOT DETERMINE.

lines.item: Banana battery-contact PCB - custom, bare board + contacts
lines.qty_basis: one board clamped onto power_support's pins by banana_pcb_locker (RELEASE.html §4 step 1)
lines.mpn_status: not a bought part until a design exists
lines.rfq_spec: NOT QUOTABLE YET. Spring-contact board that mates the NP-F550 pack's terminals to the HAT battery input; mounts on two 3.9 mm pins with two M2 through-eyes (2.17 mm). Contact type, plating and current rating unknown.
lines.verdict_why: Shape and contacts unknown; nothing to quote.
unknowns: Board outline, contact part, plating, current rating, price: all CANNOT DETERMINE.

rfq_suppliers.name: ROBOTIS Co., Ltd.
rfq_suppliers.address: ROBOTIS INC, 4222 Green River Rd, Corona, CA 92880 (US); ROBOTIS Co. Ltd (KR)
rfq_suppliers.ask: OEM / volume pricing for XL330-M288-T at 225, 1 500 and 15 000 units, and for Robot Cable-X3P 180 mm at 300 / 3 000 / 30 000 leads. ROBOTIS publishes no XL330 bulk pack and no tier table, so THIS QUOTE IS THE SINGLE LARGEST OPEN NUMBER IN THE WHOLE COST MODEL - the servos are 75 % of the readable bought cost and the only line that does not move between 1 and 1 000 robots.
also_ask: Is the XL330-M288-T's published 3.7-6.0 V input band a hard limit, or is there an OEM variant rated to 8.4 V? Our pack is 6.6-8.2 V.
Can leads be supplied at non-catalogue lengths (20, 35, 40, 50, 60, 65, 95, 120, 125, 165 mm)?

rfq_suppliers.name: Radxa / approved partner (ALLNET China, Arace, ameriDroid, OKdo)
contacts: via https://radxa.com/products/zeros/zero3w/ - 'exclusively available through our network of Approved Partners'
rfq_suppliers.ask: Price and lead time for the ZERO 3W in the configuration Pollen specifies (1 GB LPDDR4 / 32 GB eMMC, 40-pin header pre-soldered). NOTE: this configuration is NOT in Radxa's own SKU table (RAD-DOC-0084 rev 1.10 §7). Confirm whether it can be built to order, and quote RS107-D1E8H1W15 and RS107-D4E32H1W15 alongside. Every 1 GB variant was sold out at every distributor on 2026-09-02 - a real lead time is needed.
also_ask: Availability commitment: the product brief §8 states availability 'until a minimum date of September 2030'. Confirm for the quoted SKU.
Price and lead for the matching 22-pin 0.5 mm CSI FFC in a ~15 mm length.

rfq_suppliers.name: DigiKey
rfq_suppliers.ask: Quote the semiconductor and connector lines at 1 / 100 / 1 000 robots. Several carry long factory lead times read on 2026-09-02 (LSM6DSV16X 24 weeks, PN7150 30 weeks, ST25R3916 28 weeks and 0 in stock, FUSB302BMPX 56 weeks, S-8252AAX 0 in stock until 23-Dec-2026, BMI088 0 in stock until 08-Sep-2026) - confirm scheduled-order pricing and whether the lead times still hold.
also_ask: Is there a 35 x 25 x 7 mm, 8 ohm, 2 W rectangular speaker in the catalogue? Nothing at that exact size was findable; both parts we priced are oversize.

rfq_suppliers.name: LCSC Electronics
rfq_suppliers.ask: Quote the same semiconductor lines at 1 / 100 / 1 000 robots, on reel where the reel quantity is reached. LCSC is 30-55 % below DigiKey on most of these lines; confirm authorised-channel provenance and date codes, because that gap is large enough to need an answer before it is trusted (the PN7150 is $3.9307 vs $9.095 at 100).
also_ask: Do you stock the Etek ET7301B (or ET7301BY)? It is the USB-C PD controller Radxa fits, and no distributor with a price was found anywhere.

rfq_suppliers.name: Bearing suppliers (NZ Miniature Bearings; Jiang Xin Technology; a US/EU miniature-bearing house)
rfq_suppliers.ask: Quote MR1622 / ET2216 (16 x 22 x 4) at 11 / 1 100 / 11 000 pieces and MR6700 / 61700 (10 x 15 x 3, OPEN) at 3 / 300 / 3 000 pieces, in USD. The only USD figure we could read for the 16x22x4 is a factory RANGE of US$1.00-4.00 at MOQ 1 000 - a range is not a price.
also_ask: Quote ZZ (shielded), 2RS and open for both sizes - which variant the product uses is unresolved.
State OD tolerance and roundness: both bearings are press-fit into printed PLA seats.

rfq_suppliers.name: Fastener supplier (RST-Versand; or any house that will quote at volume)
rfq_suppliers.ask: Quote DIN 912 / ISO 4762 A2 socket-head cap screws at 100 / 10 000 / 100 000 pieces: M2x4, M2x6, M2x8, M2x12, M2.5x6; plus DIN 934 A2 M2 hex nuts. Only the M2x6 has a readable price anywhere (EUR 4.34 per 100, RST-Versand) and no vendor publishes a tier above 100.
also_ask: Quote M2 brass heat-set inserts (~3.0 mm) at 100 / 6 000 / 60 000 - Prusa, CNC Kitchen and Vector3D all stop at a 100-piece pack.

rfq_suppliers.name: Battery pack supplier (NextBatteries / Neewer / an OEM pack maker)
rfq_suppliers.ask: Quote a 7.2 V 2S Li-ion pack in the Sony NP-F550 (L-series) form factor, >= 2600 mAh / 18.72 Wh, with integrated protection, at 1 / 100 / 1 000 packs, and the matching charger separately. Body must be 70 x 38 x 20 mm class (our cradle is cut to 38.6 x 20.6 x 70.8 mm).
also_ask: State the cell make and model, the protection IC, the Wh rating and every certification mark on the label. The pack Pollen fits is unidentified and we cannot put an MPN on an order without this.
Confirm the pack sustains 6.6-8.2 V under a 15 A peak (15 servos x 1 A worst case).

rfq_suppliers.name: Camera module supplier (Arducam / UCTRONICS / Seeed)
rfq_suppliers.ask: Quote an IMX219 M12-mount camera board at 1 / 100 / 1 000, with and without lens, plus a 22-pin 0.5 mm MIPI CSI FFC at ~15 mm. Seeed's 102110719 is the only line with a published tier (10+ at $12.50) - extend it to 100 and 1 000.
also_ask: Does B0183 ship WITH the M12 lens? UCTRONICS' package list says yes; The Engineer Store's page for the same SKU says the lens is separate.
What is the shortest 22-pin 0.5 mm FFC you make? We need ~15 mm and no catalogue part that short was findable.

rfq_suppliers.name: ToF supplier (Pololu / SparkFun / ST direct)
rfq_suppliers.ask: Quote the VL53L8CX carrier (Pololu #3419) and the VL53L5CX Qwiic Mini (SparkFun SEN-19013) at 1 / 100 / 1 000; neither publishes a tier above 100. Also quote the bare VL53L8CXV0GC/1 and VL53L5CXV0GC/1 at 1 000 and 3 600 for placement on our own HAT - at >= 100 robots the bare die is $6.06-6.72 against $19.43 for the cheapest carrier.
also_ask: Confirm the VL53L8CX's IOVDD restriction (1.2/1.8 V only) - it decides whether the carrier is optional.

rfq_suppliers.name: Filament supplier (GigaParts / 3D Universe / Bambu Lab direct)
rfq_suppliers.ask: Quote Bambu Lab PLA Basic and TPU 85A, 1.75 mm, 1 kg, at 1 / 100 / 1 000 spools. At 1 000 robots this is 218.3 kg of PLA and 26.2 kg of TPU; no vendor publishes any volume tier on filament and Bambu's own store refuses the fetcher (HTTP 402).
also_ask: Confirm TPU 85A vs 90A availability - our slice used the 85A preset and the product's real durometer is unresolved.
